Name: Shop Expander
Author: Entoarox
Description:
[center][b][size=4]As of SDV 1.6 the vanilla game provides all the features of this mod.
Because of this ShopExpander has been deprecated and will not be updated any longer.

Thank you for your support while this mod was active![/size][/b][/center]

This mod lets you buy often-needed resources like wood/stone/seeds in bulk from the appropriate vendor. It comes with a fully editable config to change how these things are setup.


[b]Install steps[/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2269]Install Entoarox Framework[/url].[/b]
[*]Unzip the download into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[b]Use[/b]
This mod uses the Custom Conditions System included in the Entoarox Framework library; see [url=https://github.com/Entoarox/StardewMods/blob/master/Framework/docs/conditions.md]the documentation[/url] for more info.


[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Compatible with...[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.3.32 or later;
[*]Linux, Mac, and Windows;
[*]single-player and multiplayer.
[/list]
[/list]
